name: js-chunks
description: Idiomatic TypeScript/JS wrapper around a WASM-backed Rust document chunking engine for RAG — 36 file formats, images, and PDF; runs on Node, Bun, Deno, and browsers.
author: Ranjan Kudesia <ranjan.kudesia@gmail.com>

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/chunks-wasm --target nodejs --out-dir ../../pkg-node --out-name chunks_wasm && wasm-pack build crates/chunks-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../pkg-web --out-name chunks_wasm && rm -f pkg-node/.gitignore pkg-web/.gitignore
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:wasm && npm run test

//: WASM artifacts (pkg-node / pkg-web) are built via `npm run build:wasm` (requires the Rust toolchain + wasm-pack). Bundled browser apps import the `js-chunks/web` subpath (pkg-web) and serve chunks_wasm_bg.wasm as an asset. PDF is parsed by the engine itself — there is no peer dependency. `npm test` builds dist/ first so the dist smoke test always runs against fresh output.
